course.title: Khaemenes Academy Second Grade — Subject-Based 36 Week A+ Curriculum
course.subtitle: Universal Second Grade Readiness · In-House Subject Curriculum · Advanced Whole-Child Foundation
course.dependencyPolicy: No outside fonts, scripts, images, libraries, or curriculum calls. All pages use local files only.
course.localReviewNote: Designed to exceed a single-state checklist by spanning broad second-grade subject domains. Local requirements should still be reviewed by the family, evaluator, or institution.

standardsFamilies.label: Grade 2 Language Arts
standardsFamilies.description: Foundational skills, decoding, fluency, comprehension, vocabulary, grammar, writing, speaking, listening, and research.

standardsFamilies.label: Grade 2 Mathematics
standardsFamilies.description: Base-ten notation, addition/subtraction fluency, standard measurement, data, time/money, shapes, and problem solving.

standardsFamilies.label: Grade 2 Science and Engineering
standardsFamilies.description: Matter, plants, animals, habitats, Earth materials, weather, forces, patterns, observation, and design.

standardsFamilies.label: Grade 2 Social Studies and Civics
standardsFamilies.description: Community, culture, geography, history, economics, citizenship, maps, public goods, rules, and service.

standardsFamilies.label: Arts and Music
standardsFamilies.description: Creating, performing/presenting, responding, connecting, rhythm, visual design, drama, movement, and portfolio reflection.

standardsFamilies.label: Health, PE, and SEL
standardsFamilies.description: Movement skills, health habits, safety, cooperation, self-management, relationship skills, responsible decisions, and wellness.

standardsFamilies.label: Technology and Tools
standardsFamilies.description: Digital citizenship, privacy, safe tool use, sequencing, algorithms, debugging, data organization, and creative communication.

standardsFamilies.label: Portfolio and Assessment
standardsFamilies.description: Weekly evidence, subject mastery, midterm, final, 80% completion, portfolio conference, and family-controlled records.

units.title: Scholar Routines and Reading Stamina

language-arts.activity: Model, practice, discuss, and create evidence for reading stamina and complete sentences.
teacherScript: Introduce Reading in student-friendly language.
Model one clear example and think aloud.
